focus: Portfolio websites: personal portfolios for designers, developers and product builders (case studies, shipped projects, about/resume pages), and portfolio sites built for clients or small studios. Builders work in code (React/Next.js/Tailwind, often with AI coding agents) or in no-code tools.

quality_bar.redundancy_rule: A candidate that overlaps an existing Core/Strong record must name that record id and a concrete differentiator (price, license, framework, output, skill level); otherwise drop it or propose it as a replacement.

sources.note: Filter by tags such as animation, scroll, react-components, css, 3d; rank by weekly star trend.
Tutorials: propose only the libraries/tools they introduce, not the articles.
Signal: mine tools/templates credited on portfolio features.
Signal for no-code portfolio patterns; propose template sources, not individual templates.
Mine 'Technologies & Tools' tags on winning portfolio pages. Never propose the sites themselves.
